name: Bolivia Cubing Tour - Potosí 2025

venue.name: Centro Cultural IV Centenario
venue.address: Avenida Antofagasta, Plaza Bolívar, Frente a la Caja Nacional de Salud en el Salón Principal

information: **The Bolivia Cubing Tour Potosi 2025** will be the Third competition of an exciting tour that will take place **in four different cities across Bolivia, between January 19 and 26**. This will be the perfect opportunity for competitors from all over the country to join a unique speedcubing experience, enjoying thrilling tournaments in various locations. This competition is open to all public. To see all the information about register payment go to the next [Link](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BoliviaTourPotosi2025#53111-instrucciones-de-pago) ​ **More information about the competitions enter to: [Frequently Asked Questions / FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BoliviaTourPotosi2025#53046-faq-pmf)** ​ **El Bolivia Cubing Tour Potosi 2025** será la tercera competencia de un emocionante tour que se llevará a cabo en **cuatro ciudades diferentes de Bolivia, entre el 19 y el 26 de enero**. Esta será la oportunidad perfecta para los competidores de todo el país de unirse a una experiencia única de speedcubing, disfrutando de emocionantes torneos en distintas localidades. Esta competencia esta abierta a todo publico.
